requirement_text.REQ-001b: Extract remaining hardcoded copy from all 12 landing components into messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json, wire via next-intl getTranslations/t.rich(). 5 acceptance criteria: (1) no hardcoded Cyrillic remains in the 12 components; (2) matching 177-key catalogs; (3) every new uz value non-empty; (4) clean build; (5) both /ru and /uz render all 12 sections with no missing-key errors.

task.description: Independently re-verify REQ-001b per WF-02 Step 5 — do not trust TEST-RUNNER's report alone. (1) Re-run npm run lint && npm run build yourself. (2) Re-run the Cyrillic sweep and key-set diff scripts yourself (cheap, load-bearing checks). (3) Start the server yourself and spot-check at least 2-3 of the rendered-output cases with your own curl commands, not by re-reading the report. (4) Confirm all 5 acceptance criteria against actual current code/output. (5) Check docs/agents/requirements.yaml's REQ-001b entry for staleness relative to what actually shipped — note FRONTEND-DEV reported 2 MINOR deviations already reviewed/accepted by REVIEWER (indexed-key naming for MapSection/Streams/Metrics not spelled out in the design, and Streams' foundationTitle/foundationLink extraction) — decide if requirements.yaml itself needs any correction.
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint && npm run build re-run independently, real output quoted
Cyrillic sweep and key-set diff re-run with your own commands
At least 2-3 rendered-output cases re-verified with your own curl commands
All 5 acceptance criteria explicitly confirmed against actual code/output
requirements.yaml staleness check performed and stated
